descriptor.name: Scriptorium Shadows
descriptor.image_style: Deep ink-wash and graphite charcoal on vellum: heavy, textured blacks (#0a0a0f) bleed into warm shadow greys (#2d2e35), with faint candle-glow highlights in amber (#c9a66b) and cool stone grey (#5c6068). The mood is hushed, reverent and atmospheric; sharp pen lines define architecture while soft washes suggest depth. Let Space Ghost's white suit read as pale parchment-white with subtle ink shading. Avoid saturated colors or modern neon tones.
descriptor.scene: A dimly lit medieval monastery scriptorium at night, candlelight flickering on high stone walls lined with leather-bound manuscripts and wooden shelves. Space Ghost stands solemnly among the monks' workstations, wearing his classic costume but rendered in ink-wash style: white suit shaded with light grey washes, black hood and mask detailed in heavy charcoal, yellow cape muted to a warm ochre tone, red power bands rendered as deep burnt sienna. He holds a quill pen upright with serious focus, appearing to transcribe Latin text on parchment alongside wooden desks scattered with ink pots and scrolls. The scene is respectfully composed, with no sacred objects parodied; the humor comes entirely from his alien presence being treated with complete seriousness in a historic Christian setting.
